text: In the year one ninety-three, the Roman Empire was sold... at an auction.
asr: In the year 193, the Roman Empire was sold at an auction.

text: The palace guards had just killed the emperor.
Then they offered the throne to the highest bidder.
The emperor's father-in-law offered every soldier twenty thousand coins.
A rich senator, Didius Julianus, bid twenty-five thousand.
asr: A rich senator, Didius Julianus, bid 25,000.

text: He won, and the Senate made him emperor.
Sixty-six days later, a rival general marched on Rome... and Julianus was executed.
He bought an entire empire, and kept it for just sixty-six days.
